summary: Implemented every module under src/vstg/ from the skeleton: core sizing and bit/shard hashing (blake2b with separate personalizations, Kirsch-Mitzenmacher bit positions), the mutable BloomFilter bit array, persist serialization with a checked header and atomic save, ManagedBloomFilter, ShardedBloomFilter with per-shard dirty tracking, BloomFilterRegistry, and the module-level API, leaving tests untouched. The last full-suite run on the whole tests directory passed 117 tests with 0 failures (exit status 0).
